name: Doctrine Feature
summary: Enforcement Doctrine Feature Riot Shield When you take the Dodge action with a shield, one adjacent ally also gains +2 AC. Executioner Your Executioner damage becomes +1d8. Investigator When you hit a creature you have studied or identified, add your Wisdom modifier to the damage once per turn.
